messages:
deploybot: Deployment attempt to staging started for tag release-v1.12.4 (commit 3a7f9b2). Scope: web + runtime. CI gate: running.
ci-bot: CI job failed: integration-tests (kv-cache-eviction.test) — 1 failing, 48 passed. Logs: <https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/4382/artifacts/logs/integration-tests>
anna-k: saw it, failing test looks like nondeterministic eviction on long sequences. grabbing logs.
mike-r: @anna-k can you paste the failing trace? also did we change cache semantics in this PR?
anna-k: stacktrace snippet:
```
E AssertionError: expected 0 keys but found 1
  at tests/cache/test_eviction.py:42
```
jen-li: tagging @sre-oncall — this blocks canary; failing integration prevents rollout. any quick mitigations?
sre-oncall: looked at the job — failure spikes only on gpu nodes with 16GB. Could be timing/quantization interaction. Recommend pinning to previous tag for canary and rerunning integration in a dedicated queue.
mike-r: agree. Options: 1) abort canary and pin to release-v1.12.3; 2) rerun the flaky test with repeat flag to confirm. Preference 1 for safety during change window.
anna-k: we need release notes update noting rollback/pin and root cause investigation.
jen-li: plan: abort canary, pin tag release-v1.12.3, open a follow-up ticket to debug eviction on 16GB. I'll update release notes.
deploybot: Abort acknowledged. Rolling back canary to tag release-v1.12.3 (commit 1f4b2d8). Deploy status: ABORTED — CI gate failed. Manual unblock required to retry.
ci-bot: Rerun job command: `./ci/retry_job.sh integration-tests 4382` (enqueued) — link: <https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/4382>
mike-r: I'll queue the rerun in the isolated GPU queue, leaving canary pinned. ping here when green.
anna-k: filed ticket: INF-2317 — kv-cache eviction on 16GB quantized runtime. adding logs and repro steps.
jen-li: I'll update release notes and notify PMs. Good call to pin.
sre-oncall: monitoring for rollback side effects — if any downstream jobs fail I'll escalate.
deploybot: Canary now pinned to release-v1.12.3. Status: STABLE -> canary blocked. To proceed, new PR or manual unblock after CI green. :thumbsup:
